title: Built a platform for TTRPG lovers
author: RollForAI
selftext: Just launched my mvp for a TTRPG platform where campaign creators build a full rpg campaign using a map, quests, npcs, triggers, etc and then players can run those campaigns. The game master/narrator role is done by an AI with the story details inserted when appropriate. I'd love some feedback on what works, what doesn't, and what features should be added next!

comments.author: RollForAI
comments.body:
Landing page with more details/videos: [https://www.rollforai.com/](https://www.rollforai.com/)

comments.author: Disastrous_Seesaw_51
comments.body:
I don't know if this is a problem with reddit or what...maybe im too new to this...
Thisbis a nice map and all..
But what does it actually do...
And what is it useful for. Not trying to be a smartass.. Unclear what this integrates into if anything

replies.author: RollForAI
replies.body:
Oh that's definitely not a problem with reddit or with you. I'm trying to find a balance between writing all my features and making a post that's short but interesting, and I think I missed the mark with this.

  
The map in the video is what the campaign builder looks like. Its what someone that wants to create the RPG campaign would use to add NPCs, cities, and any kind of map annotations (think like an rpg game map at a high level). The map along with the story description, quests, etc combine to make the campaign that other users can then play.

  
You can see a short video of what it looks like in this section here: [https://www.rollforai.com/#features](https://www.rollforai.com/#features) or if you sign up to the app you can play two stories that I have set up.

  
At the moment the campaign builder is not available (I'm doing a short player-only alpha phase) but I just wanted to show what it looks like from the other side.
